theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A S : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℕ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet S → A ⊆ S → CountablyRectifiable n S → Measurable θ → (∀ x ∈ S, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ∫⁻ x in S ∩ K, (θ x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ζ (μHE[n].restrict A) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q) → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.carrier = A ∧ R.mult = θ ∧ R.orient = ζ
